create_blip_image_processor: create a BlipImageProcessorPil instance for preprocessing images for the BLIP model
process_blip_image: process a single PIL or numpy image through resize, rescale, normalize and RGB conversion for BLIP
resize_blip_image: resize an image to 384x384 using BICUBIC resampling for BLIP image processing
normalize_blip_image: normalize an image using OPENAI_CLIP mean and standard deviation for BLIP model input
convert_blip_image_to_rgb: convert an image to RGB format for BLIP model preprocessing pipeline
